facts.fact: The page cites a PDSA 2022 report for an estimate of 12 million dogs in the UK.
The page cites a PDSA 2022 report for an estimate of 12 million cats in the UK.
According to PFMA 2019 data (averaged over 2016–2019 surveys), 26% of the UK population lives with dogs.
According to PFMA 2019 data, the UK has about 6,604 thousand households with dogs.
According to PFMA 2019 data, the UK averages 1.4 dogs per household, and about 9,000 thousand dogs in total.
According to PFMA 2019 data, London has the highest share of households with dogs at 92%.
According to PFMA 2019 data, Northern Ireland has 40% of its population living with dogs.
According to PFMA 2019 data, 18% of the UK population lives with cats.
According to PFMA 2019 data, the UK has about 4,995 thousand households with cats and averages 1.6 cats per household.
According to PFMA 2019 data, the UK has about 8,000 thousand cats in total.
The page reports, citing Mintel 2015, that over a quarter of pet owners admit they like to pamper their pets.
